reviews.text: Called to get a price for feline euthanasia. They require an exam,  not a problem.  They DO NOT allow you to be with your pet during the process but you can see them after.  This does not sound very humane to me,  they should probably change their name.  Makes one wonder what exactly you're doing to my beloved pet while behind closed doors.
The doctor is so nice. The staff is really friendly prices are really well and they do really take care of your pet. I wouldn’t take it nowhere else.
The vet was very good and all the staff were very friendly
I am very Happy with Holiday Humane Society Clinic...... Thanks for your Great service.

Clinic used to be a great place to take it to have your dog or pet checked out at a low cost but since the previous doctor retired they have a new doctor and he doesn't want to basically do any checkups or anything for any pets I took my dog been going there for over 10 15 years told me to take it to the hospital and have them put IV in it I can't check it wanted to see if he had an infection or anything ear infection and a reception is even rude like we can't check them we can't do that.

I called in to see what it would cost to have my dogs bad tooth extracted and was told they dont give out prices over the phone that I would have to come in, pay the 40$ head fee just to be told what it would cost me. And when I politely pointed out the absurdity of that, again in a very polite conversational tone, she hung up on me.

Great service you guys have here! You are really doing good for the animals in pain! Bravo
They are low cost vet. No hidden fees and upsetting. Only thing is they are usually booked and have limited hours of operation.

Great place to go to and support, I use to take my dog or pets throughout the past 30 years, but recently I brought another rescue young cat in to be neutered. This is the second redcue cat I've fixed at Holiday Humane, recently, Bob and Rigby. Prices are reasonable,  I see it as my fees are essentially donating to their cause of helping animals housed there and providing low cost vet to pets in need. They accept donations as well. I'm sure they would love ❤️ your support.

I also like the fact that you do not have to wait long for an appointment, which is essential for any per. The doctors are caring and very good there, and Gabby and staff are friendly and helpful. Thank You.
It’s the humane society, and their prices are insane. Don’t even bother calling.
